text.p: Results of four-day Supersport Series cricket matches which finished on Monday:

In Cape Town: Western Province beat Western Province by 39 runs. Western Province 220 and 399 (S.Koenig 97, D.Haynes 71, E.Simons 61), Northern Transvaal 355 and 226. Western Province 14 points, Northern Transvaal 8.
In Durban: Border beat Natal by four wickets. Natal 332 and 257, Border 205 and 385-6 (P.Kirsten 90, F.Cronje 67, P.Strydom 61). Natal 8 points, Border 14.
In Paarl: Boland beat Griqualand West by 195 runs. Boland 268 and 260, Griqualand West 250 and 83 (R.Telemachus 6-21). Boland 16 points, Griqualand West 6.
